title: Plants drawn at 3 pixels per cell instead of 1
question: Same stand, same simulation, same screen area. One is the shipped 1:1 render magnified; the other reconstructs each cell's shape at sub-cell resolution. Which reads as trees? And does the smooth one look better to you, or does it just look blurry / washed out?
context_md: 14,857 plant cells (7,470 foliage + 7,387 wood) — identical world, identical frame, no simulation change of any kind. The window already gives every cell a 2x2 block of physical pixels and paints all four the same colour; this spends them instead. Cost is not free and is being measured separately.
